_about: The reject_words.py hook reads this list. Each category holds words (whole words or phrases, case-insensitive; a word joined by a hyphen or underscore never matches), why (one sentence), instead (what to write) and an optional ask (the question that separates the legitimate exception; resubmitting the identical write once answers it). Add a category when a word keeps coming back after being corrected by hand. The exempt entry is not a category: its tags list the frontmatter tags that mark a whole file as somebody else's words.

figurative-load.why: Used figuratively, these read as machine-written filler and are cringeworthy in documentation.
figurative-load.instead: Name the actual relation: holds, stores, includes, names, sets, depends on, is required for.
figurative-load.ask: do these words describe carrying or propping up a literal physical object or structure? if not, use other words and stop generating AI slop, please and thank you!

vague-vocabulary.why: A consultant word for the systems we work on; the reader needs the specific thing.
vague-vocabulary.instead: Say which it is: the platform, the connectors, the repo.
